msg: Purple and pink tend to perform well at similar times during the game, as do brown and green. The advice I was given indicated that blue and purple went together well, but on my screen there was no blue. The performance tends to follow a trend it would seem as well.  When purple and pink did well, they sometimes gradually decreased on a downward trend.  When below 5, I started trying to switch to brown and green sometimes helped.  During some parts of the game, it seemed like I would get below 5 regardless of my choices.
